reviews.comment: Do you like getting no response from your emails? If so, you're in luck because Chester has never answered a single email in her life. She is the most unorganized professor you will ever have. In class assignments are worth 30% of your grade, but sometimes she forgets to open it during class and it becomes homework due at 5pm.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr.Chester is the nicest professor I've had. She was always willing to talk after class about the lecture, but her class lacked structure, assignments would regularly not get posted, Exams had a lot of repeated and poorly written questions, final never got graded, there were projects in the syllabus that were never assigned. Exams were very easy
This Prof was my favorite! I loved her so much, she was very kind and compassionate. Always gave notice before a test or quiz. Overall 10/10 would take her class again.

We learned exam 1 content 2 weeks after taking it. She admitted to giving us the wrong exam for exam 2, & only gave a 5 point curve to fix it. Final course grades were due the 22nd and she never even gave us a grade for our final exam. She's disorganized and unprepared. She makes an easy class unbelievably difficult. Take anyone else!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst prof here. Actually don't think she can teach at all. It was a joke and a complete waste of money and time. If confusion were the learning objective, the course was a success. Lectures lacked structure, clarity, and any meaningful instructional value. This course desperately needs a new instructor or a complete redesign.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Probably the most disorganized class I've been in. She cares a lot about rocks but she put exam 2 material on the first exam's test, which we didn't learn yet. The lectures are long and boring & it's hard to stay focused for the entire 90 minutes. Assignments also don't help us either. I'm never sure what I need to know for an exam or not.

Attendance sometimes mandatory (she will randomly do in class assignments but won't tell you when). She is the sweetest prof ever, but is horrible at responding to emails. Things take forever to grade, nothing is posted in canvas, everything is so unorganized. Lectures are boring. But, easy to do well on tests if you go over slides night before.

Where to begin about Professor Chester....DON'T DO IT!!! She is a super nice lady and seems to really care about geology and rocks, but the same can not be said about her assignments. She makes them up on the fly and forgets to post assignment submission spots. Her submission system needs serious work, and she changes her mind every 5 minutes. 0/10

Easily the most disorganized class I have ever been in. The content is not hard but she constantly forgets to post the turn in for the in class assignments and will randomly make up assignments for us to do in class that don't make any sense. She had us take the wrong test this semester and had to heavily curve the exam.

The lectures are pretty boring, and the tests have a bunch of repeated questions along with errors. She says that she'll publish an assignment, but she never does it on time. She just changed a deadline for a project. You can tell she tries somewhat during lectures by bringing stuff in and asking us questions to keep us engaged, but its useless.

This class is so boring I'm writing this review in her class right now.

She cannot teach, attendance is mandatory, and class is a complete mess. I've never seen a professor be more disorganized or careless about the classes they're paid to teach. Instructions are always unclear, she forgets to post assignments on Canvas, and she's late to tests.

I honestly don't think she knows how to teach. I'm surprised she's still a professor here. Her behavior is also very odd. Whenever a girl goes up to ask a question, she looks annoyed like they're bothering her, but when a guy goes up, she suddenly lights up and smiles like it made her day.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Not sure why she has such awful ratings. Very respectful and knowledgeable about her field. Lab is the hardest part about this class. Biggest downside - she took 2 months to grade exam 1. Dr. Chester is very specific about how she wants you to show your work. As long as you actually do this, your grade will be fine. I'm expecting to make an A or B

I thought Dr. Chester was a great professor when I took her class. She was always very kind and respectful to students. The course materials was definitely difficult, but Dr. Chester provides a lot of resources to help you learn. If you put in the effort you can do very well in the class. Great prof!

Good prof, hard subject w/ unclear expectations on test questions, too many questions for the time and level of detail wanted. Shes caring and respectful in my experience as well as available outside hours. Im confused by the other ratings. Hardest class in the program, but thats the material, not the prof. Open note/take home/or correction test

Extremely rude and condescending professor. She will make you feel dumb for asking any question related to the class. The exams and study guides are overwhelmingly confusing, and difficult to follow. If its not what she wants to see on the exam, its wrong. If you do not follow her exact instructions that she said a month ago, you will not pass.

I am taking Dr. Chesters structural geology class right now, and its finals time She is by far the rudest, and condescending professor I have had. You are going to have to do a lot of self-learning in this class. The content is above average difficulty in my opinion, but the professor is slow, confusing and unwilling to help you. Good luck.

she does not care about her students. she is unreachable outside of normal workable hours. honestly just buy the book and read that instead of listening to her. horrible professor, worst I have ever had.

Possibly the worst professor I've ever encountered. Never worked out a single problem where math or physics was required to solve. Seemingly graded exams with arbitrary criteria and took off points without explanation. No feedback on anything we did except for points lost. Lectures were often dense, convoluted, and yet never sufficient.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She gives terrible feedback, makes you feel stupid when talking about questions you missed on exams. Even if you get the answer right on the test, if you don't show even the most basic math you will only get half credit. Almost impossible to follow the lectures unless you have a PHD yourself. Good luck if this class is mandatory for you.

GEOL 312 has been an incredibly tough class, not by material but by the awful professor. Grading criteria is nonexistent when it comes to the lecture exams. Much of the exams were work out problems, none of which she explained how to do at all. The closest practice material to exam questions were a series of study guides that did little to help.

Worst professor I've ever had. She does not respect her students. It's been over 3 weeks and she never gave our exam grades back. Gives homework at 2pm that is due at midnight the same day. Professor Chester makes her lectures too complicated and doesn't work examples during class. She always finishes class 7-10minutes overtime.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Horrible about giving out information, posts grades and assignments last minute. Flies through lectures, doesnt stop to let us ask questions. Teaches topics in the most difficult way possible when there is an easier way of explaining.
If you don't follow her instructions to the letter, you're done for.
